from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlySingleFamilyCompletion(BaseModel):
    """A monthly record of single-family housing completions from a single report."""
    month: str = Field(description="The month of the reported data in YYYY-MM format")
    value: float = Field(description="The Not Seasonally Adjusted completion count (e.g., in thousands)")
    unit: str = Field(description="The unit of measurement for the value, e.g. 'thousands'")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="The release date of the source report in YYYY-MM-DD format, used to resolve conflicting values by precedence")
    report_code: str | None = Field(description="Optional report identifier (e.g., 'CB25-94') for traceability")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    completions: list[MonthlySingleFamilyCompletion]
